article.content: Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to empower any Court of Small Causes to make an order for the attachment of immovable property.]
article.html:
13Small Cause Court not to attach immovable property.

Order 38, Rule 13

Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to empower any Court of Small Causes to make an order for the attachment of immovable property.]

2 Ins. by Act 1 of 1926, s. 4.
